title: Charitable strategies: DAFs, CRTs, charitable LLCs
summary: Donor-advised funds, charitable remainder trusts, qualified charitable distributions from IRAs. Tax-advantaged philanthropy.
detailsHtml:
Donor-Advised Funds

Contribute appreciated securities (avoiding capital gains), take an immediate full-value charitable deduction, then distribute to charities over time. Effective for "bunching" deductions in high-income years to clear the standard deduction threshold.

Charitable Remainder Trusts

Transfer appreciated assets into a CRT, receive income for life (or term of years), with remainder going to charity. Immediate partial deduction, deferral of capital gains, lifetime income stream. Useful for business owners selling a business with low basis.
